def _supported_line(x, y):
    if len(x) < 4 or np.ptp(x) < 0.5:
        return None
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    use = np.abs(x[i] - x[j]) >= 0.25
    i, j = (i[use], j[use])
    g = (y[i] - y[j]) / (x[i] - x[j])
    b = y[i] - g * x[i]
    residual = np.abs(y[:, None] - x[:, None] * g - b)
    counts = (residual <= 0.002).sum(axis=0)
    best = np.lexsort((np.minimum(residual, 0.002).sum(axis=0), -counts))[0]
    clean = residual[:, best] <= 0.002
    if clean.sum() < max(4, len(x) // 2 + 1) or np.ptp(x[clean]) < 0.5:
        return None
    return np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack((x[clean], np.ones(clean.sum()))), y[clean], rcond=None)[0]

def _design(tau, x, h, p, dt, t, yield_stress):
    after = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    decay = np.exp(-after[:, None] / tau)
    jump = -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau)
    gap = h[:, None] - p @ (decay * jump)
    shape = -np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)
    ov = np.maximum(np.abs(h) - yield_stress, 0.0) ** 2 * np.sign(h)
    work = np.maximum(np.abs(p) - yield_stress, 0.0) ** 2 @ dt * h
    curves = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * shape, x[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None], ov[:, None, None] * t[None, :, None], work[:, None, None] * shape[None, :, :1]), axis=2)
    rates = np.column_stack((gap / tau, x, ov, work / tau[0]))
    return (curves, rates)

def _line(x, y):
    """Resistant pairwise slope start, then refit with bounded influence."""
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    dx = x[i] - x[j]
    good = np.abs(dx) > 1e-06
    if not good.any():
        return np.array([1.0, np.median(y - x) if len(x) else 0.0])
    slope = np.median((y[i[good]] - y[j[good]]) / dx[good])
    b = np.array([slope, np.median(y - slope * x)])
    a = np.column_stack((x, np.ones(len(x))))
    for _ in range(8):
        r = y - a @ b
        s = max(0.0001, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r))))
        w = 1.0 / np.hypot(1.0, r / (2.5 * s))
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(a * w[:, None], y * w, rcond=None)[0]
    return b
